sharpe_methodology_note: Sharpe 0.77 computed on 363 directional-trade returns annualized by sqrt(52). Alternative Sharpe 0.50 (labeled sharpe_alt_weekly_basis) computed on the full 850-week return series with FLAT weeks treated as 0%, annualized by sqrt(52); this is the stricter convention. Both figures use zero risk-free rate. Directional-trade mean and standard deviation are per-trade percentage returns on nominal (entry price times 100 oz contract).
mean_return_universe: Per directional trade only. FLAT weeks are excluded from the numerator and denominator; if averaged across all 850 weeks in the sample (including 487 FLAT weeks), mean drops proportionally to about +0.10% per week.
